dimensions.question: Does the delivered video do what the prompt asked, at the stated duration, format and tone?
Does every shot honour the approved visual direction — palette, register, lighting language?
Are subjects placed and framed with intent, with readable depth and blocking?
Do characters match their approved sheets across every shot?
Does the product match its approved geometry, materials and markings?
Is the environment the same place from shot to shot?
Is motion plausible — no sliding, morphing, seams or frozen ranges?
Does the camera do what the shot plan specified, and nothing else?
Do subjects contact, hold and move objects believably?
Do landmarks, screen direction and the axis agree across shots?
Does the cut carry the intended rhythm, with each shot at a length it earns?
Was the strongest take chosen, on motion evidence rather than a still?
Are sound, music and picture in sync and balanced so required information is heard?
Where a voice is present, is it the same voice with the same performance profile throughout?
Where text or graphics are present, are they legible, correctly spelled and inside safe areas?
Does the master decode, at the declared resolution, frame rate and duration, with audio where required?
Do delivery variants keep the critical subject in frame and text readable?
Was work approved by a human, were plans reconciled, and were retries bounded?
Does the result read as a deliberate film rather than a generic rendering of the prompt?

gates.question: Does the delivered video honour every approved creative decision without silent revision?
Where a character or product is required to match a reference, does it?
Is there no broken spatial, environment or wardrobe continuity between shots?
Does each delivery variant meet its declared target?

readiness: A repeat is production-ready when no applicable hard gate fails and every required scored dimension is 2 or higher. Dimensions are reported separately and never summed. A visually attractive video that breaks an approved product design or contains invalid media is not production-ready.
